title: golden-set-annotation/v1 record
description: One reviewed or draft annotation record for a single golden-set question. A record is only scorable when annotation.review_status is REVIEWED; DRAFT_UNVERIFIED records are candidates and must never contribute ground truth to an official run.

sample_id.description: 1-based zero-padded line number in the source golden set. Deterministic, so a record always maps back to its question.

question.description: Copied verbatim from the source golden set. Not reworded.

visual_required.description: true ONLY when the question cannot be answered from text alone and requires reading an image, label, diagram or scanned page. A human decision. Never derive it from business_type == 'image', which marks a domain, not a visual dependency.

complexity_label.description: Whether a single retrieval hop suffices. A human/reference label. Never record a Router prediction here — that would measure the classifier against its own output.

corpus_version.description: The sealed knowledge epoch the doc_id/chunk_id identifiers resolve in.

corpus_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the corpus fingerprint this mapping was made against, from benchmarks.corpus.CorpusFingerprint.content_sha256. Binds the mapping to an exact index state so a chunk id cannot silently refer to a different revision.

annotations.description: Every supporting passage for this question. More than one is normal: 1081 ground-truth passages span the 301 committed questions.

chunk_id.description: Chunk identity within the document. The evaluation key is 'doc_id::chunk_id', so two chunks of one document stay distinguishable.

text.description: The passage as it exists in the indexed corpus at corpus_version. Used for auditing the mapping, not as the match key.

relevance.description: 0 not_relevant (a candidate that was considered and rejected; excluded from scoring), 1 partially_relevant, 2 highly_relevant. Binary Hit/Recall treat >=1 as relevant; graded NDCG uses the full scale.

annotator.description: Who produced this record. Required even for an LLM candidate: an unattributed record cannot be audited later.

method.description: How the passages were mapped, e.g. manual-passage-mapping, manual-visual-review.

source.description: llm_candidate means a model proposed the mapping. It stays DRAFT_UNVERIFIED until a person reviews it.

review_status.description: No default. A record that does not state its review state is rejected.

reviewed_by.description: Required when review_status is REVIEWED. Must differ from annotator: self-review defeats the point.

promoted_by.description: Required when an llm_candidate is promoted to REVIEWED, so the promotion itself is auditable.
